items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Now, once again, here is your moderator, Joe Collado.

ctx.x: Well, I could get the name and address of a place in London. I probably could order it out of Doug Doble's record shop there. I think that's 77 Charing Cross Road, London, England. But I could give you an exact address if you'll call me tomorrow at Tulane. Call you at Tulane? Yes. I sure will. Hi, Moose. Hi. Moose is a wonderful cornet player. Yeah. Do you take requests, Moose? Play Make Me a Pallet on the floor next time we get up there. Okay. Okay. Play the saints, will you? Okay. Okay. Thank you for calling,…
Now, once again, here is your moderator, Joe Collado.

And we have calls and calls and calls, and we're going to try to get to most of them this morning. I don't know if that's possible, but you could keep trying. It's 523-2404. No use. There it goes. Okay. The gentleman did not have this on the agenda to play, and I said, look, we have lots and lots of saints fans out here. What about the saints? And they said, okay, play the saints, go marching in. But you've got to give us equal time to comment on it afterwards. So we're going to play it first, as heard by the…
